blocker.message: finding reviewer:f1 invalidates the plan; eval row r2 was wrong, so the eval needs a re-sign

signed_rows.behavior: Bifrost is pinned to exactly 2.7.0 in deployments/applications/services.tf, the AirHelp-OSP/bifrost provider stays at ~>0.1.0, and scripts/bifrost_smoke.py still treats `access_not_found` as the unknown-key refusal.
signed_rows.fails_when: the pin is any other version or a floating tag, the provider constraint moves, or the smoke script stops expecting `access_not_found`

signed_rows.behavior: .okf/components/bifrost.md records that the operator chose no pre-apply dump (2026-11-27), that the 2.3.1 to 2.6.0 store migrations already ran and are partly one-way, so there is no restore point to 2.3.1, and that 2.6.0 to 2.7.0 adds two reversible migrations.
signed_rows.fails_when: the page claims a dump or rollback path that does not exist, or omits that there is no way back to 2.3.1

signed_rows.behavior: After the apply, job bifrost runs healthy on v2.7.0; scripts/bifrost_smoke.py passes against it (inference auth, metrics auth, the four named virtual keys, an embedding routed to embark); a bare-string rerank through the OpenViking virtual key returns 200; one chat call to Gemini returns 200; and a second terraform plan of deployments/applications changes no bifrost_virtual_key.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of those fails, or its evidence is not recorded in the review

signed_rows.behavior: .okf/components/bifrost.md and any other page naming the current Bifrost version say 2.7.0, and the component page notes that bifrost_upstream_latency_seconds no longer counts queue wait since 2.6.0.
signed_rows.fails_when: a page still names 2.3.1 or 2.6.0 as current, or the latency note is missing

resigns.reason: Operator moved the target from 2.6.0 to 2.7.0 and told the implementer to skip the pre-apply dump (2026-11-27); r1 now pins 2.7.0 and r2 records that there is no restore point to 2.3.1.
